sections.Profile:
"Captain Kidd" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1960. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one passive bumper, and two slingshots.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
